name: Charlie Dankert
current_role: Chief of Staff, U.S. Department of Energy (since August 2026)
summary: Charlie Dankert became Energy Secretary Chris Wright’s chief of staff when Carl Coe, a former DOGE lead at the department, stepped down effective July 31, 2026. Wright called Dankert a key member of his leadership team; he had been deputy chief of staff for policy.
